name: 30311 · Atlanta, GA
findings: ZIP 30311 (Atlanta) has 163 nonprofit organizations. 61 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30311 (Atlanta) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few religious organizations list membership
observations.text: 5 religious organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 14 would.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through religious groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 16 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30311 (Atlanta) list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 41% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
